03 / Behind the work

A researcher’s curiosity.
A developer’s mindset.

I work across software development, natural language processing and teaching. My research centres on Sepedi–English text generation and the challenges of building language models with limited data.

My background combines Computer Science and Statistics, with a focus on problem analysis, database design and reliable software. I work with Git, GitHub and Docker, and have experience in an Agile environment.

As a lecturer at Rosebank College, I help students connect programming concepts with practical problem solving. That same focus on clarity shapes how I approach software and data.
